title: Addressable fire-alarm Class A loop
goal: A reader must be able to trace the panel’s outgoing and returning Class A loop through addressable devices and distinguish the supervised sounder circuit.

rubric.must: The FACP LOOP OUT connection passes through all listed field devices and visibly returns to the distinct FACP LOOP IN connection.
A smoke detector, heat detector, manual call point, and second smoke detector are visible in sequence on the loop.
A 6.8 kΩ EOL MONITOR is shown at the remote end near the loop-return connection.
The panel block is labelled FACP PANEL and Notifier NFS-320.
A separate panel sounder output passes through a 1 A fuse and feeds two 24 VDC sounders in parallel.
The loop supervision and sounder circuits show a readable shared COM return.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. The loop leaves the panel, passes through four addressable devices in series and returns to LOOP IN, with the end-of-line monitor at the far end and the sounders on their own fused branch off a shared COM.
